```{python}
#| include: false

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
while ROOT != ROOT.parent and not (ROOT / "streamlit_app").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import pandas as pd

from streamlit_app.utils import (
    OFFICIAL_GPU_INSIGHT_TAG,
    OFFICIAL_GPU_REPLAY_TAG,
    OFFICIAL_PD_RAPIDS_BENCHMARK_TAG,
    OFFICIAL_RAPIDS_TRADEOFF_FULL_TAG,
)

def _detect_current_hardware() -> dict[str, str]:
    info: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        lscpu = subprocess.check_output(["lscpu"], text=True)
        for line in lscpu.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("Model name:"):
                info["cpu"] = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        free_h = subprocess.check_output(["free", "-h"], text=True)
        for line in free_h.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("Mem:"):
                info["ram"] = line.split()[1]
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        gpu_line = subprocess.check_output(
            ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version", "--format=csv,noheader"],
            text=True,
        ).splitlines()[0]
        gpu_name, gpu_mem, driver = [part.strip() for part in gpu_line.split(",")]
        info["gpu"] = gpu_name
        info["vram"] = gpu_mem.replace(" MiB", " MB")
        info["driver"] = driver
    except Exception:
        pass
    info["platform"] = "WSL2"
    return info

hardware = _detect_current_hardware()

registry_rows = [
    {
        "Carril": "Replay GPU oficial",
        "Run tag": OFFICIAL_GPU_REPLAY_TAG,
        "Ruta principal": f"reports/gpu_replay/{OFFICIAL_GPU_REPLAY_TAG}/run_summary.json",
        "Rol": "comparación stage-by-stage contra baseline CPU oficial",
    },
    {
        "Carril": "Benchmark PD separado",
        "Run tag": OFFICIAL_PD_RAPIDS_BENCHMARK_TAG,
        "Ruta principal": f"reports/gpu_replay/{OFFICIAL_PD_RAPIDS_BENCHMARK_TAG}/artifacts/run_summary.json",
        "Rol": "separar fit-only, full-stage y HPO",
    },
    {
        "Carril": "Insight Factory RAPIDS",
        "Run tag": OFFICIAL_GPU_INSIGHT_TAG,
        "Ruta principal": f"reports/gpu_insights/{OFFICIAL_GPU_INSIGHT_TAG}/artifacts/run_summary.json",
        "Rol": "UMAP, HDBSCAN, cuGraph y ETL exploratorio",
    },
    {
        "Carril": "Frontier full cuOpt",
        "Run tag": OFFICIAL_RAPIDS_TRADEOFF_FULL_TAG,
        "Ruta principal": f"reports/gpu_replay/{OFFICIAL_RAPIDS_TRADEOFF_FULL_TAG}/artifacts/models/champion_portfolio_policy.json",
        "Rol": "policy selection y A/B sobre universo ampliado",
    },
    {
        "Carril": "Side-project consolidated benchmark",
        "Run tag": "2026-03-17 consolidated",
        "Ruta principal": "reports/gpu_benchmark/benchmark_summary_all_sections.parquet",
        "Rol": "índice transversal de métodos clásicos benchmarkeados en GPU",
    },
]

artifact_rows = [
    {
        "Artefacto": "Replay GPU summary",
        "Path": f"reports/gpu_replay/{OFFICIAL_GPU_REPLAY_TAG}/run_summary.json",
        "Tipo": "json",
        "Uso": "duraciones GPU, telemetría y stage registry",
    },
    {
        "Artefacto": "IFRS9 MC tail metrics",
        "Path": "data/processed/ifrs9_mc_tail_metrics.json",
        "Tipo": "json",
        "Uso": "speedup, tail metrics y equivalencia CPU/GPU",
    },
    {
        "Artefacto": "PD RAPIDS benchmark",
        "Path": f"reports/gpu_replay/{OFFICIAL_PD_RAPIDS_BENCHMARK_TAG}/artifacts/run_summary.json",
        "Tipo": "json",
        "Uso": "fit-only vs full-stage vs HPO",
    },
    {
        "Artefacto": "Insight stage summary",
        "Path": f"reports/gpu_insights/{OFFICIAL_GPU_INSIGHT_TAG}/artifacts/run_summary.json",
        "Tipo": "json",
        "Uso": "UMAP, HDBSCAN, cuGraph, cuDF ETL",
    },
    {
        "Artefacto": "Insight detail tables",
        "Path": f"reports/gpu_insights/{OFFICIAL_GPU_INSIGHT_TAG}/artifacts/data/processed/*.parquet",
        "Tipo": "parquet",
        "Uso": "embeddings, perfiles de clusters y comunidades",

    {
```

## Notas editoriales

- `models/gpu_consolidated_summary.json` sirve como índice de hardware y secciones, pero no como tabla maestra de claims publicables.
- `data/processed/gpu_consolidated_table.parquet` es útil para recordar qué métodos clásicos se benchmarkearon, no para reemplazar la lectura de los runs oficiales.
- Las claims fuertes deben trazarse contra `run_summary.json`, `ifrs9_mc_tail_metrics.json` y el ledger interno [docs/GPU_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_LEDGER.md](../../docs/GPU_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_LEDGER.md).
